Join IMPRS-CPQM in 2027!
Are you excited about the idea of pursuing a PhD degree in quantum materials research? Then we might have something for you: we are offering more than 20 projects in the fields of condensed matter physics or solid-state chemistry.
We are looking for highly motivated PhD students with an outstanding Bachelor or Master degree in a field of study which is well-aligned with our research activities.
If you are interested in joining IMPRS-CPQM and would like to work in a stimulating research environment, we invite you to apply for admission into our research school. For the current recruiting cycle, please submit your application no later than 30 November 2026. We are looking forward to hearing from you. You can find detailed application guidelines HERE.

Welcome to the IMPRS-CPQM!
The International Max Planck Research School for Chemistry and Physics of Quantum Materials (IMPRS-CPQM) is a tri-institutional collaboration of the Max Planck Institute for Chemical Physics of Solids in Dresden, Technische Universität Dresden and the University of St Andrews.
By working together, we create a highly attractive overall package of PhD level research on materials chemistry and physics including access to world-leading facilities, a large range of graduate level courses across both disciplines, and specially designed skills training (both academic and non-academic).
We recruit PhD students from all over the world, and offer them an internationally leading PhD programme. This results in a cohort of lively, enthusiastic PhD students who relish international opportunities and the chance to work at the cutting edge of our field.
